result.stdout:
Hexalith FrontComposer CLI

Usage:
  frontcomposer inspect [--type <metadata-name>] [--project <path>] [--solution <path>] [--configuration <name>] [--framework <tfm>] [--build] [--format text|json] [--severity hidden|info|warning|error] [--fail-on-warning] [--fail-on-error] [--absolute-paths]
  frontcomposer migrate --from <version> --to <version> [--dry-run|--apply] [--project <path>] [--solution <path>] [--format text|json] [--fail-on-findings]

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 explicit fail-on-findings, 2 invalid/ambiguous input, 3 generated output unavailable, 4 apply/write failure.
Path support: --project requires .csproj; --solution requires .sln with exactly one .csproj. .slnx and .fsproj fail closed in v1.
Inspect fail flags: --fail-on-warning is stricter than --fail-on-error when both are supplied.
Migrate JSON: applied is true only after a clean --apply run; diffs are terminal-safe informational output, not a patch contract.
